questions.stem: What is the role of companion cells in phloem tissue?

options.text: They photosynthesize to produce sugars for transport
They absorb water from the soil by osmosis
They provide energy (ATP) and metabolic support for sieve tube elements
They provide structural support to the plant stem

questions.explanation: Companion cells have many mitochondria and a nucleus, providing the ATP and metabolic control needed for the active loading of sucrose into sieve tube elements during translocation.
